title: cyperus coronarius
intro: Cyperus coronarius, commonly known as the Umbrella Sedge or Purple Umbel, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus coronarius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents in this plant are responsible for its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
